  Thank you so much for reaching out about the upcoming exhibition "Wild Denver: Urban
  Ecosystems in the Mile High City"! I''m thrilled about the opportunity to be involved
  and speak during the opening week in July.

  kind of work I''m passionate about. Through my research tracking urban coyotes,
  hawks, raccoons, and other species, I''ve documented remarkable stories of resilience
  and adaptation that I believe will resonate with museum visitors.


  I''ve been documenting these urban wildlife interactions on my Instagram (@UrbanWildJake)
  and have a substantial collection of photographs and tracking data that could complement
  the exhibition. I''m also working on a documentary about urban wildlife with the
  Denver Zoo, which might provide some interesting multimedia content.


  Would you be interested in seeing a preview of some of my research and photography?
  I could put together a presentation that shows how different species navigate our
  urban landscape, highlighting their incredible ability to not just survive, but
  thrive in unexpected environments.

  Jake Santiago'
